automations.name: GM Morning Briefing
automations.description: Generates morning briefing report for each GM using hotel-gm-briefing skill and hotel-data MCP tools
automations.prompt: Run the /morning-briefing command. Use the hotel-gm-briefing skill. Query get_property_summary and get_arrivals_departures and get_night_audit for today. Format as a structured morning briefing report with sections: Last Night Summary, Today's Forecast, Action Items, Alerts. Save the report.

automations.name: Daily Revenue Flash
automations.description: Portfolio-wide revenue summary for district managers and SVP
automations.prompt: Run the /portfolio-flash command. Use the hotel-portfolio-analysis skill. Query get_portfolio_overview for all regions. Format as an executive revenue flash with sections: Portfolio KPIs, Regional Breakdown, Top/Bottom Performers, Rate Position Summary. Save the report.
